what: New python-pyright job is missing from existing CI failure classification and local replay contracts
scenario_or_breakage: After .github/workflows/ci.yaml adds python-pyright, make lint can fail because test-ci-failed-jobs requires every workflow job to be mapped; pyright-only CI failures also become no-local-equivalent and can stall the merge/fix loop instead of using the Python lint fix path
suggested_fix: Add the minimal python-pyright mappings to the shell and Python allowlists, map local replay to a pyright-only equivalent such as pyright -p python/pyrightconfig.json after installing python/requirements-dev.txt, and update the narrow existing tests only
